question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` intentionally stop accepting plus-prefixed and zero-padded spellings that currently resolve to the exact requested cadence?
rationale: The current parser explicitly accepts these forms, the documentation does not define canonical textual spelling, and the cited sibling fixes address coercions that change numeric meaning rather than equivalent spellings.

options.title: Preserve equivalent spellings
options.body: Keep the existing safe-integer and lower-bound contract because these inputs do not alter the requested cadence.

options.title: Require canonical spelling
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document decimal canonicalization as part of the CLI contract, and require upgrade and real-launcher proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve equivalent spellings
recommendation.body: Keep the existing safe-integer and lower-bound contract because these inputs do not alter the requested cadence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Policy extension and its CLI contract in the merged feature history.
